reasoning: This glyph is standard UI chrome for 'align bottom' in graphic editors, though out of context it also resembles a minimal two-bar chart. Because it is primarily an editor toolbar button and easily confused with a bar graph or pause symbol, it makes a poor, ambiguous task icon.
